69901.grammar: prp of vīmaṃsiyati, desid, pass, intrans
69901.meaning1: being investigated; being examined; being tested
69901.base: √man + man + sa + iya > mamaṃsiya > vīmaṃsiya (desid, pass, irreg)

69902.commentary: (NIDD1) so vīmaṃsī'ti paṇḍito paññavā buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvī'ti ñatvā muni nissaye so vīmaṃsī. (DNa) vīmaṃsāya samannāgato'ti vīmaṃsī. vīmaṃsā nāma tulanā ruccanā khamanā. yathā hi puriso yaṭṭhiyā udakaṃ vīmaṃsitvā otarati, evam'eva yo tulayitvā ruccitvā khamāpetvā diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, so vīmaṃsī'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, sandaka, idh'ekacco satthā takkī hoti vīmaṃsī. so takkapariyāhataṃ vīmaṃs'ānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
eṇijaṅghaṃ kisaṃ vīraṃ, app'āhāraṃ alolupaṃ, sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ, kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ, upasaṅkamma pucchāma, kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti
asaṃsayassa kusalassa, venayikassa sārathivarassa, anuttarassa ruciradhammassa, nikkaṅkhassa pabhāsakassa, mānacchidassa vīrassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
hitvā ratiñ'ca aratiñ'ca, sītibhūtaṃ nirūpadhiṃ, sabbalok'ābhibhuṃ vīraṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
nānājanā janapadehi saṅgatā, tava vīra vākyaṃ abhikaṅkhamānā, tesaṃ tuvaṃ sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.

69908.commentary: (MNa) vīrānaṃ aṅgaṃ vīr'aṅgaṃ, vīrakāraṇaṃ vīriyan'ti vuttaṃ hoti. vīr'aṅgaṃ rūpaṃ etesan'ti vīr'aṅgarūpā

examples.text: parosahassaṃ kho pan'assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr'aṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.

69911.meaning1: effort; energy; might; power; strength; vitality

examples.text: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.

āraddhavīriyo viharati, kāmaṃ taco ca nhāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ, na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī'ti.

69912.commentary: (SNa) balavīriyan'ti ettha balaṃ nāma vāyodhātu, vīriyaṃ kāyikacetasikavīriyam'eva.

examples.text: tesaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse, tiṇ'odakasaṅkhaye, adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti. tesaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyānaṃ balavīriyaṃ parihāyi.

69913.commentary: (MNa) kusītā'ti kosajj'ānugatā. hīnavīriyā'ti hīnā vīriyena virahitā viyuttā, nibbīriyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. tattha kusītā kāyikavīriy'ārambhavirahitā honti, hīnavīriyā cetasikavīriy'ārambhavirahitā. te ārammaṇavavatthānamattam'pi kātuṃ na sakkonti. tesaṃ avavatthit'ārammaṇānan'ti sabbaṃ pubbasadisam'eva. (THa) samaṇadhammaṃ kātuṃ cittassa ussāhābhāvena hīnavīriyā

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, etadahosi, ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kusītā hīnavīriyā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, kusītahīnavīriyasandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

69916.meaning1: for the sake of effort and exertion

69917.meaning1: power that is effort; strength of energy
69917.commentary: (ANa) vīriyabalādīsupi es'eva nayo. ettha hi saddhā assaddhiye na kampati, vīriyaṃ kosajjena na kampati, sati muṭṭhassaccena na kampati, samādhi uddhacce na kampati, paññā avijjāya na kampatī'ti sabbāni'pi akampiy'aṭṭhena balānī'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, udāyi, akkhātā mayā sāvakānaṃ paṭipadā, yathāpaṭipannā me sāvakā pañca balāni bhāventi. idh'udāyi, bhikkhu vīriyabalaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ. tatra ca pana me sāvakā bahū abhiññāvosānapāramippattā viharanti.
handa viyāyāma byāyāma, mā no mayaṃ parapessā ahumhā, tesaṃ duve vīriyam'ārabhiṃsu, anussaraṃ gotamasāsanāni.

69921.meaning1: balanced effort; equilibrium of force; relaxed effort; (comm) energy combined with calm
69921.commentary: (ANa) vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhahā'ti vīriyasampayuttaṃ samathaṃ adhiṭṭhaha, vīriyaṃ samathena yojehī'ti attho.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, soṇa, vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhahaṃ, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjha, tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
atha kho āyasmā soṇo aparena samayena vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhāsi, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjhi, tattha ca nimittaṃ aggahesi.

69922.meaning1: comprised of meditative composure based on energy and active effort

examples.text: so chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, cittasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīmaṃsāsamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, ussoḷhī'y'eva pañcamī.

69923.meaning1: comprised of meditative composure based on energy and active effort

examples.text: idha, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu chandasamādhi-ppadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhi-ppadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti

69924.meaning1: effort as an element of awakening; energy as a factor of enlightenment

examples.text: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vīriyasambojjh'aṅgaṃ, atthi me ajjhattaṃ vīriyasambojjh'aṅgo'ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vīriyasambojjh'aṅgaṃ, n'atthi me ajjhattaṃ vīriyasambojjh'aṅgo'ti pajānāti
yasmiñ'ca kho, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo vīriyasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo pītisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.
kiṃ pattinam'āhu vedaguṃ, anuviditaṃ kena kathañ'ca vīriyavā'ti, ājāniyo kin'ti nāma hoti, puṭṭho me bhagavā byākarohi.
adhisīlaṃ adhicittaṃ, adhipaññañ'ca vīriyavā, thāmavā dhitimā jhāyī, sato gutt'indriyo care.

69926.meaning1: who is a proponent of the doctrine of making effort; who holds the view of the efficacy of applying energy

examples.text: te'pi, bhikkhave, makkhali moghapuriso paṭibāhati, n'atthi kammaṃ, n'atthi kiriyaṃ, n'atthi vīriyan'ti. aham'pi, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kammavādo c'eva kiriyavādo ca vīriyavādo ca.
evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yaṃ taṃ tejaṃ vīriyā nimmathitaṃ padhān'ābhinibbattaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ vimuttiyā vimuttin'ti.
tañ'hi tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno dīgharattaṃ app'icchatāya santuṭṭhiyā sallekhāya subharatāya vīriy'ārambhāya saṃvattissati

kullan'ti kho, bhikkhave, ariyass'etaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi… sammāsamādhi. tassa hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyāmo'ti kho, bhikkhave, vīriy'ārambhass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

69929.meaning1: talk on arousing energy; discussion about making an effort

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca āraddhavīriyo vīriy'ārambhakathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

appicchakathā, santuṭṭhikathā, pavivekakathā, asaṃsaggakathā, vīriy'ārambhakathā, sīlakathā, samādhikathā, paññākathā, vimuttikathā, vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā'ti, imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa kathāvatthūni.

69932.meaning1: power of effort; faculty of energy

examples.text: aparāni'pi pañc'indriyāni saddh'indriyaṃ vīriy'indriyaṃ sat'indriyaṃ samādh'indriyaṃ paññ'indriyaṃ
tassa cittaṃ rakkhato āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu saddh'indriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. vīriyindriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.

69933.meaning1: ending of effort; cessation of the faculty of energy

examples.text: ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… vīriy'indriyaṃ pajānanti, vīriy'indriyasamudayaṃ pajānanti, vīriy'indriyanirodhaṃ pajānanti, vīriy'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānanti… te kho me, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu c'eva samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu ca brāhmaṇasammatā

69934.meaning1: leading to the ending of effort; going to the cessation of the faculty of energy

examples.text: ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… vīriy'indriyaṃ pajānanti, vīriy'indriyasamudayaṃ pajānanti, vīriy'indriyanirodhaṃ pajānanti, vīriy'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānanti… te kho me, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu c'eva samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu ca brāhmaṇasammatā

69935.meaning1: appearance of effort; arising of the faculty of energy

examples.text: ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… vīriy'indriyaṃ pajānanti, vīriy'indriyasamudayaṃ pajānanti, vīriy'indriyanirodhaṃ pajānanti, vīriy'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānanti… te kho me, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu c'eva samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu ca brāhmaṇasammatā

69936.construction:
dvi + dasa + ā + a
vīsā + a

examples.text: dissat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, cātumahābhūtiko kāyo ekam'pi vassaṃ tiṭṭhamāno… vīsati'pi vassāni tiṭṭhamāno

pa, parā, ni, nī, u, du, saṃ, vi, ava, anu, pari, adhi, abhi, pati, su, ā, ati, api, apa, upa, pahāro, parābhavo, nihāro, nīhāro, uhāro, duhāro, saṃhāro, vihāro, avahāro, anuhāro, parihāro, adhihāro, abhihāro, patihāro, suhāro, āhāro, atihāro, apihāro, apahāro, upahāro, evaṃ vīsati upasaggehi ca.

69938.commentary: (SNa) vīsatikhāriko'ti māgadhakena patthena cattāro patthā kosalaraṭṭhe ekapattho hoti, tena patthena cattāro patthā āḷhakaṃ, cattāri āḷhakāni doṇaṃ, catudoṇā mānikā, catumānikā khārī, tāya khāriyā vīsatikhāriko.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho. tato puriso vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena ekam'ekaṃ tilaṃ uddhareyya, khippataraṃ kho so, bhikkhu, vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho iminā upakkamena parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya, na tv'eva eko abbudo nirayo.

69939.meaning1: with a quorum of twenty monks

examples.text: parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttari chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ, ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.
ekena'pi ce ūno vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho taṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya, so ca bhikkhu anabbhito, te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.

69940.meaning1: living for three hundred and twenty years; with a lifespan of three hundred and twenty years

examples.text: asītivass'āyukānaṃ manussānaṃ saṭṭhivassasat'āyukā puttā bhavissanti… saṭṭhivassasat'āyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsatitivassasat'āyukā puttā bhavissanti…

69941.meaning1: in twenty ways; into twenty; into twenty pieces
69941.construction:
dvi + dasa + ti + dhā
vīsati + dhā

examples.text: araṇisahitaṃ dvidhā phālesi, tidhā phālesi, catudhā phālesi, pañcadhā phālesi, dasadhā phālesi, vīsatidhā phālesi, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ akāsi, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā udukkhale koṭṭesi, udukkhale koṭṭetvā mahāvāte opuni, app'eva nāma aggiṃ adhigaccheyyan'ti.
kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi vīsatibhikkhusahassāni.

69946.construction:
dvi + dasa + ti + ma
vīsati + ma

examples.text: tesaṃ āyunā'pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena'pi parihāyamānānaṃ cattārīsavassasahass'āyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsativassasahass'āyukā puttā ahesuṃ.

69948.meaning1: twenty years old; twenty years in age

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ ūnavīsativassaṃ puggalaṃ upasampādeyya, so ca puggalo anupasampanno, te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, idaṃ tasmiṃ pācittiyaṃ.
ūnavīsativasso nāma appattavīsativasso.

69949.commentary: (VINa) vīsativasso vā'ti upasampadāya vīsativasso tato atirekavasso vā.

69950.meaning1: twenty years of age; twenty years old

examples.text: pañcadvārikā pavatte pañcadvāravasena pavattamānā paṭhamavaye vīsativassakāle rajjanadussanamuyhanavasena adhimattā balavatī hoti, paṇṇāsavassakāle ṭhitā hoti, saṭṭhivassakālato paṭṭhāya parihāyamānā asītinavutivassakāle mandā hoti.
kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.

69952.meaning1: living for twenty thousand years; with a lifespan of twenty thousand years

examples.text: tesaṃ āyunā'pi parihāyamānānaṃ vaṇṇena'pi parihāyamānānaṃ cattārīsavassasahass'āyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsativassasahass'āyukā puttā ahesuṃ.

69953.meaning1: living for twenty years; with a lifespan of twenty years
69953.commentary: (DNa) vīsativass'āyukā'ti mātāpitaro pāṇ'ātipātā paṭiviratā, puttā kasmā vīsativass'āyukā ahesun'ti khettavisuddhiyā. tesañ'hi mātāpitaro sīlavanto jātā. iti sīlagabbhe vaḍḍhitattā imāya khettavisuddhiyā dīgh'āyukā ahesuṃ. ye pan'ettha kālaṃ katvā tatth'eva nibbattā, te attano'va sīlasampattiyā dīgh'āyukā ahesuṃ.

examples.text: te kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu āyunā'pi vaḍḍhissanti, vaṇṇena'pi vaḍḍhissanti. tesaṃ āyunā'pi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ vaṇṇena'pi vaḍḍhamānānaṃ dasavass'āyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsativass'āyukā puttā bhavissanti.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, tvaṃ vīsativass'uddesiko'pi paṇṇavīsativass'uddesiko'pi hatthismim'pi katāvī assasmim'pi katāvī rathasmim'pi katāvī dhanusmim'pi katāvī tharusmim'pi katāvī ūrubalī bāhubalī alam'atto saṅgām'āvacaro'ti?

69957.meaning2: distance of one hundred and twenty yojanas; distance of approximately two thousand four hundred kilometres

tam'enaṃ cakkhumā puriso muñcitvā paccavekkheyya ime sālī ime vīhī ime muggā ime māsā ime tilā ime taṇḍulā'ti

69964.meaning1: is called, friend; is said to be, brothers

examples.text: katamā c'āvuso, suññatā cetovimutti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati, suññam'idaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā'ti. ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, suññatā cetovimutti.
lobho akusalamūlaṃ doso akusalamūlaṃ moho akusalamūlaṃ idaṃ vuccat'āvuso akusalamūlaṃ.

69965.meaning1: is said to be; is called

examples.text: yo bālo maññati bālyaṃ, paṇḍito vā'pi tena so, bālo ca paṇḍitamānī, sa ve bālo'ti vuccati.
kiñ'ca, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ vadetha? ruppatī'ti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā rūpan'ti vuccati

69966.meaning1: being spoken to; being addressed; being told (by)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udake lekhā khippaṃ'y'eva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo āgāḷhena'pi vuccamāno pharusena'pi vuccamāno amanāpena'pi vuccamāno sandhiyati'm'eva saṃsandati'm'eva sammodati'm'eva.
tam'enaṃ bhikkhū evam'āhaṃsu, m'āyasmā ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamī'ti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno evam'āha, ime hi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti, kim'aṅgaṃ pan'āhan'ti?

69967.meaning1: fact of being said; fact of being stated

examples.text: kassa pan'etaṃ sahassan'ti? hayavāhanan'ti anantaraṃ vuccamānattā hayānan'ti ayam'attho viññāyat'eva. hayā vāhanaṃ etassā'ti hayavāhanaṃ.

69968.meaning1: words being spoken; words being said

examples.text: [evarūpaṃ evarūpāya-iti vuccamānavacanena sameti. vinayena'pi saṃsandetabbaṃ]

69969.meaning1: they themselves are said to be; they themselves are called

examples.text: brahmā'ti mātāpitaro, pubb'ācariyā'ti vuccare, āhuneyyā ca puttānaṃ, pajāya anukampakā.
vuṭṭhamhi deve caturaṅgule tiṇe, saṃpupphite meghanibhamhi kānane, nag'antare viṭapisamo sayissaṃ, taṃ me mudū hehiti tūlasannibhaṃ.
upavassaṃ kho panā'ti vuṭṭhavassānaṃ.
atha kho sambahulā jātibhūmakā bhikkhū jātibhūmiyaṃ vassaṃvuṭṭhā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

69973.meaning1: spent the rainy season; lived the rains retreat; finished the rainy season
69973.commentary: (VINa) upavassaṃ kho panā'ti ettha upavassan'ti upavassa, upavasitvā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: upavassaṃ kho panā'ti vuṭṭhavassānaṃ.
sabbasaṅkhārā ca me anavatthitā khāyissanti, sabbaloke ca me mano n'ābhiramissati, sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati
yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū samaggā sannipatissanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti, samaggā saṅghakaraṇīyāni karissanti
evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ bhoto gotamassa! pahoti me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yath'āhaṃ imamhā āsanā anandho vuṭṭhaheyyan'ti.
sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati, nibbāne ca santadassāvī bhavissāmi, anusayā ca me samugghātaṃ gacchissanti

69980.meaning2: rose, arose, emerged from, is produced

examples.text: dassanaṃ me atikkante, sasaṅghe lokanāyake, haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena, āsanā vuṭṭhahiṃ tadā.
atha kho āyasmato girimānandassa dasa saññā sutvā so ābādho ṭhānaso paṭippassambhi. vuṭṭhahi c'āyasmā girimānando tamhā ābādhā. tathā pahīno ca pan'āyasmato girimānandassa so ābādho ahosī'ti.

69983.meaning2: having risen, having arisen, having emerged from

examples.text: yāni ca kho imāni, bhikkhave, nissāya dve āyatanāni, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-samāpatti ca saññāvedayitanirodho ca, jhāyīh'ete, bhikkhave, samāpattikusalehi samāpattivuṭṭhānakusalehi samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhahitvā sammā akkhātabbānī'ti vadāmī'ti.
namassamāno aṭṭhāsiṃ, sattarattin'divaṃ ahaṃ, vuṭṭhahitvā samādhimhā, satthā loke anuttaro, mama kammaṃ pakittento, idaṃ vacanam'abravi.
dassanaṃ me atikkante, sasaṅghe lokanāyake, sayanā vuṭṭhahitvāna, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujiṃ tadā.

69985.meaning2: rises, arises, emerges from, is produced

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu taṃ tadeva samāpattiṃ samāpajjati'pi vuṭṭhāti'pi, tassa mudu cittaṃ hoti kammaññaṃ. mudunā kammaññena cittena appamāṇo samādhi hoti subhāvito.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya paripūrakārī. so yāni tāni khudd'ānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati'pi vuṭṭhāti'pi.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco gilāno labhanto vā sappāyāni bhojanāni alabhanto vā sappāyāni bhojanāni, labhanto vā sappāyāni bhesajjāni alabhanto vā sappāyāni bhesajjāni, labhanto vā patirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ alabhanto vā patirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ n'eva vuṭṭhāti tamhā ābādhā.

69988.meaning1: (of meditation) to emerge (from); to come out (of)

69989.meaning1: to stand up; to rise; to get up (from)
69989.meaning2: to stand up; to rise; to get up (from)

examples.text: āyāmi āvuso, āyāmi āvuso'ti vatvā tatth'eva saṃsappasi, na sakkosi āsanā'pi vuṭṭhātun'ti. evam'pi kho, bhaggava, vuccamāno acelo pāthikaputto āyāmi āvuso, āyāmi āvuso'ti vatvā tatth'eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā'pi vuṭṭhātuṃ.

yāni ca kho imāni, bhikkhave, nissāya dve āyatanāni, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-samāpatti ca saññāvedayitanirodho ca, jhāyīh'ete, bhikkhave, samāpattikusalehi samāpattivuṭṭhānakusalehi samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhahitvā sammā akkhātabbānī'ti vadāmī'ti.
kati pan'āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā vuṭṭhānāyā'ti? dve kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā vuṭṭhānāya, sabbanimittānañ'ca manasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā amanasikāro.
maraṇamattañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ yadidaṃ aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati. yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati.

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa, kiñ'c'āpi tathārūpiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, atha kho naṃ khippam'eva satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu deseti vivarati uttānīkaroti, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.

69992.meaning1: going beyond; transcending; rising to the next level
69992.commentary: (ANa) vuṭṭhānan'ti vodānam'pi vuṭṭhānaṃ, tamhā tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhānam'pi vuṭṭhānan'ti

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṃkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, yv'āyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ vuṭṭhānakusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
